summary: CEIR-13b sec-50 ceir.transfer: complete data-movement semantics -- copy (buffer/image/buffer-image/image-buffer, and SUBRESOURCE copies via VIEW operands -- shipped), clear, mip generation, upload (host->device), readback (device->host). HOST-authorable op vocabulary (ADR-0109): the ops live in crd-ceir; the crd-ceir-gpu BRIDGE lowers them onto the canonical command model / IComputeContext at CEIR-13d (core NEVER links gpu-context -- I3/I4). ⛔ effects are STATIC per-op-kind (a copy ALWAYS reads src / writes dst -- unlike ceir.compute's per-instance ambient baseline: there is no per-instance access here to defer): copy = Write{dst} + Read{src}, upload/clear = Write{dst}, readback = Read{src}, mip_gen = ReadWrite{image}. So a transfer HAZARDS its neighbours PRECISELY (the upload->first-read barrier scar is Write{dst}-then-Read{dst} = RAW, by construction) and -- unlike a dispatch -- does NOT extend an UNRELATED resource's 12c live range (the effect names a specific operand, never the whole Memory class). All ops RESULTLESS (host materialization for readback is provider-side; the sec-129 oracle compares OUTSIDE the IR). Well-formedness rides the module-walk verifier Context::find_transfer_misuse. ⛔ KNOWN HOLE (struck-in-place at 12c, retrofit named-forward): a transfer through a VIEW escapes ops_hazard today (distinct SSA Values assumed non-aliasing); 13b does not widen it but makes it easier to hit -- transfers through views are natural. ⛔ NO-FOLLOW (named, never silently subset): sec-50's tensor copy + blit + resolve + peer copy + sparse page mapping/upload + compression/decompression -> CEIR-13+/26; a TYPED image clear (this slice's `value` is the buffer FILL WORD only) -> CEIR-13d/render (aligns with RAH-1a.1's typed clear: clear_kind Float|Uint + clear_uint).

ops.name: clear
ops.summary: Clear a resource to a value (the buffer fill word); a typed image clear is CEIR-13d.
ops.docs: transfer.clear(%dst) {value=N}. Static effect: MemoryWrite{dst}. find_transfer_misuse: dst transferable -> value kind-fold (ClearValueInvalid if present + non-Int) -> value placement (ClearValueOnImage if present + dst underlying is Image).

operands.name: dst
operands.doc: the resource to clear (written); a Buffer/Image or a View of one

attributes.name: value
attributes.doc: the buffer FILL WORD (u32 pattern; absent = 0). ⛔ a `value` on an IMAGE clear is ClearValueOnImage -- typed image clears are 13d/render

ops.name: copy
ops.summary: Copy a resource (or a subresource via a view) from src to dst; operand order is (dst, src).
ops.docs: transfer.copy(%dst, %src). ⛔ (dst, src) order. Static effects: MemoryWrite{dst} + MemoryRead{src}. find_transfer_misuse: dst transferable -> src transferable -> src != dst (CopySrcIsDst).

operands.name: dst
operands.doc: the DESTINATION (written); a Buffer/Image or a View of one

operands.name: src
operands.doc: the SOURCE (read); a Buffer/Image or a View of one

ops.name: mip_gen
ops.summary: Generate the mip chain of an image (reads the base level, writes the derived levels).
ops.docs: transfer.mip_gen(%image). Static effect: MemoryReadWrite{image}. find_transfer_misuse: the operand (through a view one-hop) is an Image (else MipGenNotImage).

operands.name: image
operands.doc: the image whose mip chain is generated (read+written); an Image or a View of one

ops.name: readback
ops.summary: Read a device resource back to the host (reads src); the host destination is a provider-resolved identity.
ops.docs: transfer.readback(%src) {dest=@h}. Device->host, RESULTLESS (host materialization is provider-side). Static effect: MemoryRead{src}. find_transfer_misuse: src transferable.

attributes.name: dest
attributes.doc: an OPEN host-destination identity tag (unchecked; provider-resolved at 13d)

ops.name: upload
ops.summary: Upload host data into a device resource (writes dst); the host source is a provider-resolved identity.
ops.docs: transfer.upload(%dst) {source=@h}. Host->device. Static effect: MemoryWrite{dst}. find_transfer_misuse: dst transferable.

attributes.name: source
attributes.doc: an OPEN host-data identity tag (unchecked; the provider resolves it at 13d -- the name/alias_group precedent)
